excluded.reason: legacy ICGS custom benchmark; not RoboHiMan semantics; known physical abstractions (handle-block drawers, marker predicates). Kept recoverable as a possible mechanistic diagnostic suite; no scientific reason found to add it to TRAIN.
not part of HiMan-Bench A/AP/C/CP; outside the benchmark scope.

lineage_rules: every episode carries split_id, split, per-episode numpy seed and factor env seed; the collector refuses (task, strategy, variation, seed) outside the split
Stage-2 anchors, branches and continuations inherit the split of their source episode
no DEV or TEST episode, failure, perturbation, branch or statistic enters gradient training or normalization statistics
held-out tasks (DEV-composition, TEST-held-out-composition) never appear in TRAIN in any form
TEST demonstrations used as inference-time context come only from test.context_seed_range
changing this manifest requires a new split_id and a new ADR; the lock file hash is checked by the collector

tracks.not_claimed: any generalization result; DEV is never reported as a test

tracks.claim: selection signal for composition of seen primitives into unseen task structures
tracks.not_claimed: test performance; no gradient from these tasks

tracks.claim: known-task robustness to new placements and new samples of TRAIN perturbation families (disjoint seeds and factor seed)
tracks.not_claimed: task, composition, asset or perturbation-family generalization

tracks.claim: robustness of known tasks to Colosseum perturbation families absent from TRAIN
tracks.not_claimed: new tasks; distractor YCB objects are new only as distractors, not as manipulated assets

tracks.claim: composition of seen primitives and assets into task structures unseen in TRAIN and DEV
tracks.not_claimed: unseen primitives or assets (overlap matrix shows both are seen)

tracks.claim: behaviour on held-out tasks with explicit prerequisite chains (open→place→close; close first drawer before second)
tracks.not_claimed: generalization of consequential decisions (audit: consequences are sparse)

unsupported_claims.asset_generalization: held-out tasks reuse TRAIN object geometry (see overlap: asset_geometry); RoboHiMan provides no held-out asset factor. Not claimable without new assets.
unsupported_claims.dependency_mechanism_generalization: the n=20 dependency audit found one consequential band (put_in_without_close, TRAIN) and none in audited DEV/TEST tasks.
unsupported_claims.unseen_primitive_generalization: all DEV/TEST primitive steps occur in TRAIN tasks.
